Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities on human single-protein target CHEMBL1075189. Join activities to assays and target_dictionary filtering by target ChEMBL ID. Join activities to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures to obtain molecule ChEMBL ID and canonical SMILES. Filter rows where standard type is IC50, standard relation is '=', and pChEMBL value is not null. Sort results by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Return the first 1000 rows.
